content.text: Tamikathout teh apinihai pâlei hoeh eiteh a yawng,
hatei tamikalan teh sendek patetlah a taran ahawi.
Khocanaw lawkeknae kecu dawk
khobawinaw tuhoitu a kâthung awh,
hatei thaipanueknae hoi panuenae katawnnaw kecu dawk
ram a kangning han.
Tamimathoe ni tamimathoe repcoungroe e teh
ca hane pek laipalah ka cetkhai e longhotui hoi a kâvan.
Kâlawk ka cettakhai e ni tamikathout a pholen,
hatei kâlawk ka tarawi ni ouk a tuk awh.
Tamikathoutnaw ni lannae thaipanuek awh hoeh,
hatei BAWIPA katawngnaw ni bangpueng hai a thaipanuek.
Tawnta laihoi a khuekhaw awm laipalah hring hlak teh
tamimathoe yuemkamculah kaawm e ahawihnawn.
Kâlawk ka tarawi e teh a lungkaang e capa doeh,
ka kâso e hoi kamyawng e ni a na pa yeirai a po sak.
Apung ka cat ni teh kalan hoeh e lahoi hnopai ka tawnta e ni
tamimathoe kabawmkung hanelah a pâtung pouh.
Kâlawk ka tarawi ngai hoeh e teh a ratoumnae hai panuet a tho.
Thoenae lam dawk tamikalan lam ka phen sak e teh
ama ni a tai e tangkom dawk a bo han,
hatei toun kaawm hoeh e ni hnokahawi a coe han.
Ka tawnta e ni amahoima a lungkaang lah a kâpouk,
hatei thaipanueknae ka tawn e tamimathoe ni peng a pâpho han.
Tamikalan a lunghawi navah kalen e bawilennae ao,
hatei tamikathout a kangdue toteh taminaw a kâhro awh.
Amae yonae ka hrawk e teh hawinae hmawt mahoeh,
hatei ka pâpho e ni pahrennae a hmu han.
Takinae pou ka tawn e teh a yawkahawi e doeh,
hatei a lung pou ka patak e teh rawkkahmanae hoi a kâhmo han.
Mathoenaw kaukkung bawi kathout teh
sendek ka huk e hoi tavom ka hram e patetlah ao.
Thaipanueknae ka vout e ukkung niteh
rep a coungroe hatei hounlounnae ka hmuhma e ukkung teh
a hringsaw han.
Tamikathet e teh phuen tangkom koe yawng na lawiseh,
apinihai ngang nahan seh.
Lam kalan dawk ka dawn e tami teh a hlout han,
hatei lam longkawi dawk ka dawn e teh vaitalahoi a rawp han.
Laikawk ka thawn e teh rawca moi a tawn han,
hatei ayawmyinlah kaawm e tami teh a mathoe han.
Yuemkamcu e ni yawhawinae kapap a hmu han,
hatei dongdengca dawk tawnta hanelah
kâcai e teh rek laipalah awm mahoeh.
Minhmai khet tawnnae teh hawi hoeh,
vaiyei tangen kecu dawk tami kâlawk ouk a tapoe awh.
Dongdengca dawk tawnta hanelah
kâcai e tami teh thoenae mit a tawn,
bout mathoe han doeh tie pouk hoeh.
Tami ka oup e hlak teh tami ka yue e ni
a hnukkhu pholennae a coe han.
A manu hoi a na pa hno ka lawm niteh,
kâtapoenae nahoeh ka tet e tami teh,
karaphoekung e hui doeh.
Tami kâoup e lungthin ni kâyuenae a tâcokhai,
hatei BAWIPA kâuep e teh a lamcawn han.
Amae pouknae ka kâuep e teh tamipathu doeh,
hatei lungang lahoi kaawm e teh hlout lah ao han.
Tamimathoenaw hno ka poe e teh vout mahoeh,
hatei ka roun e tami teh puenghoi thoebonae a hmu han.
Tamikathoutnaw a kangdue toteh
taminaw amahmawk a kâhro awh,
hatei a rawk awh toteh tamikalannaw a pung awh.
